doc.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Closing thanks
summary: Monk Rowe thanks them and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Okay, great. Well I want to thank you gentlemen for sharing this time with us, with some great insights.
Oh, my pleasure. It’s always good to — if you weren’t here we’d be sitting here doing this anyway, down in the lounge. But anyway, thanks very much.

On behalf of the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College, I want to thank Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins and I hope the rest of your festival goes great, and hope that we’ll run into you guys again real soon.
Well thank you. We’re going to do the best we can. © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
